_comment: UI metadata for ORB, read by the command-center scanner (not compiled into the strategy). 'avoid_news' sets the starting position of the News filter toggle on a backtest's results page: true = news-window trades start REMOVED (gold avoids high-impact news); the user can still flip it per run.

tldr.text: Marks the high and low of the first {ORMinutes} minutes after 9:30 on the chart's clock, meant as the New York open.
Goes long at market after two bullish closes in a row above that range; shorts mirror it below the range.
The stop sits on the far side of the range: the range low for a long, the range high for a short.
Takes profit at {RiskReward} times the risk, and closes anything still open at the ruleset's close-out time.
Takes at most one long and one short a day, and never holds both at once.
Trades only on the days and hours the ruleset allows.
Every trade is one contract; the lab's sizing engine then sets the real size from the ruleset you pick.
